title: συναποθνήσκω
content:
** συν-απο-θνήσκω [in LXX: Si 19:10 * ;]

to die with or together: Mk 14:31, II Co 7:3 (v. Meyer, in l.), II Ti 2:11.†

title: συναπόλλυμι
content:
συν-απ-όλλυμι [in LXX chiefly forספה;]

to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): c. dat. pers., He 11:31.†

title: συναποστέλλω
content:
συν-απο-στέλλω [in LXX: Ex 33:2, 12 (שׁלח), I Es 5:2 * ;]

to send along with: c. acc., II Co 12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†

title: συναρμολογέω
content:
*† συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ (< ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω,

to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Eph 2:21; of the members of the body, Eph 4:16 (Eccl.).†

title: συναρπάζω
content:
συν-αρπάζω [in LXX: Pr 6:25 (לקח), II Mac 3:27 4:41, IV Mac 5:4 * ;]

"perfective " of ἁοπάζω (v. M, Pr., 113),
(a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : Ac 27:15;
(b) to seize and hold: Lk 8:29, Ac 6:12 19:29.†

title: συναυξάνω
content:
** συν-αυξάνω [in LXX: II Mac 4:4, IV Mac 13:27 * ;]

to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: Mt 13:30 (Xen., al.).†

title: συνβάλλω
content:
συν-βάλλω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: II Ch 25:19 (גּרה hith.), Is 46:6 (זוּל), Je 50 (43):3 (סוּת hi.), Wi 5:8, al. ;]

to throw together, hence,
(a) of speech (seq. λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): c. dat. pers., Lk 11:53, WH, mg., Ac 17:18; seq. πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Ac 4:15;
(b) to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Lk 2:19;
(c) to meet with, fall in with: Ac 20:14; in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, c. dat. (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), Lk 14:31;
(d) mid., to contribute (Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): Ac 18:27.†

title: συνβασιλεύω
content:
**† συν-βασιλεύω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: I Es 8:26 A * ;]

to reign together or with: metaph., of sharing the glories of the Kingdom of God, I Co 4:8, II Ti 2:12.†

title: συνβιβάζω
content:
συν-βιβάζω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Ex 4:12, 15, Le 10:11, Jg 13:8, Ps 31 (32):8 (ירה hi.); Ex 18:16, De 4:9, Is 40:13 (ידע hi.), ib. 14 (בּין hi.), Da TH 9:22 (שׂכל hi.) * ;]

1. to join or knit together, unite: Eph 4:16, Col 2:2 (but v. infr.), ib. 19.
2. to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): Ac 16:10.
3. to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): Ac 9:22.
4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaph.), to teach, instruct: I Co 2:16, Ac 19:33, R, mg. (also in Vg., Col 2:2, instructi, but v. supr.).†

title: συνγνώμη
content:
** συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ (< συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon), [in LXX: Si prol.14 (B1א1 om.) 313, Mac 14:20* ;]

1. confession.
2. fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance: I Co 7:6 (v. ICC, in l.).
3. pardon.†

title: σύνδεσμος
content:
σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ (< συνδέω), [in LXX for קשׁר, קטר, etc. ;]

that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Col 2:19. Metaph., σ. ἀδικίας, Ac 8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Col 3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Eph 4:3 (v. Lft., Col., ll. c.).†

title: συνδέω
content:
συν-δέω [in LXX for שׁבץ, etc. ;]

(a) to bind together;
(b) to bind together with: pass., He 13:3.†

title: συνδοξάζω
content:
* συν-δοξάζω

1. to join in approving (Arist.).
2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., Ro 8:17.†

title: σύνδουλος
content:
σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: Es 4:7, 9, 17, 23 5:3, 6 6:6, 13 (כְּנָת) * ;]

a fellow-servant: Mt 18:28–33 24:49; of servants of the same divine Lord, Col 1:7 4:7, Re 6:11; so of angels, Re 19:10 22:9.†

title: συνδρομή
content:
** συνδρομή, -ῆς, ἡ (< συντρέχω), [in LXX: Jth 10:18, III Mac 3:8 * ;]

a concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: Ac 21:30 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

title: συνεγείρω
content:
συν-εγείρω [in LXX: Ex 23:5 B2 (עזב), Is 14:9 (עוּר pil.), IV Mac 2:14 * ;]

to raise together: metaph., of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, Eph 2:6; pass., Col 2:12 3:1.†

title: συνέδριον
content:
συνέδριον, -ου, τό (< σύν + ἕδρα, a seat) [in LXX: Pr 11:13 15:22, Je 15:17 (סוֹד), Ps 25 (26):4 (מַת), Pr 22:10 (דִּין) 26:26 (קָהָל); Pr 24:7 27:22 31:23, II Mac 14:5, IV Mac 17:17 * ;]

1. a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, Mt 10:17, Mk 13:9.
2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): Mt 5:22 26:59, Mk 14:55 15:1, Lk 22:66, Ac 5:21, 27, 34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6, 15, 20, 28 (WH, R, mg., om.) 24:20 of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, Jo 11:47; of the place of meeting, Ac 4:15.†

title: συνείδησις
content:
συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ (< συνεῖδον), [in LXX: Ec 10:20 (מַדָּע), Wi 17:11, Si 42:18 א * ;]

1. consciousness: c. gen. obj., He 10:2, I Pe 2:19.
2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): Ro 2:15 9:1, I Co 10:29, II Co 1:12 4:2 5:11, I Ti 4:2, He 9:14; σ. ἀγαθή, Ac 23:1, I Ti 1:5, 19, I Pe 3:16, 21; ἀσθενής, I Co 8:7, 10; ἀσθενοῦσα, ib. 12; ἀπρόσκοπος, Ac 24:16; καθαρά, I Ti 3:9, II Ti 1:3; καλή, He 13:18; πονηρά, He 10:22; ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., Tit 1:15; διὰ τὴν σ., Ro 13:5, I Co 10:25, 27, 28; κατὰ σ., He 9:9; ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., Jo 8:[9] (Rec.), I Co 10:29 (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on Ro 2:15; DB, i, 468 ff.).†

title: συνεῖδον
content:
** συν-εῖδον irreg. aor. of συνοράω (v.s. εἶδον), [in LXX: I Mac 4:21א, II Mac 2:24 4:4, 41 R 5:17 7:4, 20 8:8, III Mac 2:8 A * ;]

1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.).
2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : Ac 12:12 14:6 (on the related σύνοιδα, v. s.v.).†

title: σύνειμι
content:
* σύν-ειμι (< εἶμι, to go),

to come together: Lk 8:4.†

title: II σύνειμι
content:
σύν-ειμι (< εἰμί to be), [in LXX: Je 3:20 (רֵעַ), al. ;]

to be with: Lk 9:18 (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), Ac 22:11.†

title: συνεισέρχομαι
content:
συν-εισ-έρχομαι [in LXX: Jb 22:4 (עִם בּוֹא), etc. ;]

to enter together: c. dat. pers., seq. εἰς, c. acc. loc., Jo 6:22 18:15.†

title: συνέκδημος
content:
*† συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ (< ἔκδημος, abroad),

a fellow-traveller: Ac 19:29, II Co 8:19.†

title: συνεκλεκτός
content:
*† συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν

chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, v. ICC, in l.), I Pe 5:13.†

title: συνελαύνω
content:
** συν-ελαύνω [in LXX: II Mac 4:26, 42 5:5 * ;]

to drive together, force together: εἰς εἰρήνην, Ac 7:26, Rec. (WH, RV, συνήλλασσεν).†

title: συνεπιμαρτυρέω
content:
* συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ

to join in attesting, bear witness together with: He 2:4 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

title: συνεπιτίθημι
content:
συν-επι-τίθημι, [in LXX for שִׁית etc. ;]

to help in putting on. Mid., to join in attacking (Thuc.): Ac 24:9 (RV, joined in the charge).†

title: συνέπομαι
content:
** συν-έπομαι [in LXX: II Mac 15:2, III Mac 5:48 R 6:21 * ;]

to follow with, accompany: c. dat. pers., Ac 20:4.†

title: συνεργέω
content:
** συνεργέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I Es 7:2, I Mac 12:1 * ;]

1. prop., to work together (with): absol., Mk 16:[20], I Co 16:16, II Co 6:1; c. dat., Ja 2:22; dat. commod., Ro 8:28, T, R, txt. (but v. infr.).
2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l.): c. acc. rei, Ro 8:28 [WH] R, mg. (but v. supr.).†

title: συνεργός
content:
** συνεργός, -όν [in LXX: II Mac 8:7 14:5 * ;]

a fellow-worker: c. gen. pers., Ro 16:3, 9, 21, Phl 2:25 4:3, I Th 3:2, Rec., Phm 1, 24; θεοῦ (cf. Lft., Notes, 41, 188), I Co 3:9 (pl.), I Th 3:2 [WH] R, mg. (R, txt., διάκονον τοῦ θ.; on the original reading, v. ICC, in l.); τ. χαρᾶς ὑηῶν, II Co 1:24; τ. ἀληθείᾳ, III Jo 8; seq. εἰς, II Co 8:23, Col 4:11.†

title: συνέρχομαι
content:
συν-έρχομαι [in LXX for הלךְ, בּוֹא, אסף ni., etc. ;]

1. (cl.) to come together, assemble: Mk 3:20 14:53, T, WH, txt., Ac 1:6 2:6 10:27 16:13 19:32 21:22 22:30 28:17, I Co 14:26; seq. εἰς, c. acc loc., Ac 5:16; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, I Co 11:20 14:23; c. dat. pers., Mk 14:53, WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, v. Field, Notes, 40), Jo 11:33; ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, I Co 11:18; ἐνθάδε, Ac 25:17; αὐτοῦ, Mk 6:33, WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, Jo 18:20; c. inf., Lk 5:15; εἰς τ. φαγεῖν, I Co 11:33; εἰς τ. ἧσσον, I Co 11:17, 34; of sexual intercourse (Xen., al.; γυναικί or absol.), Mt 1:18.
2. In later sense (v. exx. in Milligan, Selections, 64, 105), to accompany: c. dat. pers., Lk 23:55, Ac 1:21 9:39 10:23, 45 11:12; seq. σύν, Ac 21:16; εἰς, Ac 15:38.†

title: συνεσθίω
content:
συν-εσθίω [in LXX: Ge 43:32, Ex 18:12 (אכל), II Ki 12:17 (בּרה), Ps 100 (101):5 * ;]

to eat with one: c. dat. pers., Lk 15:2, Ac 10:41 11:3, I Co 5:11; seq. μετά, c. gen. pers., Ga 2:12.†

title: σύνεσις
content:
σύνεσις, -εως, ἡ (< συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;]

1. a running or flowing together (Hom.).
2. (a) understanding: Lk 2:47, I Co 1:19 (LXX), Eph 3:4, Col 1:9 2:2, II Ti 2:7
(b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence: Mk 12:33.†
SYN.: v.s. σοφία

title: συνετός
content:
συνετός, ή, -όν (< συνίημι), [in LXX for נָבוֺן, חָכָם, etc. ;]

intelligent, sagacious, understanding: Mt 11:25, Lk 10:21, Ac 13:7, I Co 1:19 (LXX).†

title: συνευδοκέω
content:
** συν-ευ-δοκέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I Mac 1:57, 4:28 א1, II Mac 11:24, 35 * ;]

to join in approving, consent, agree to or with: absol., Ac 22:20; c. dat. pers., Ro 1:32; c. dat. rei, Lk 11:48, Ac 8:1; c. inf., I Co 7:12, 13 (chiefly in late writers).†

title: συνευωχέω
content:
* συν-ευωχέω, -ῶ

to entertain together. Pass., to fare sumptuously or feast together or with: Ju 12; c. dat. pers., II Pe 2:13 (Arist., Luc., al.).†

title: συνεφίστημι
content:
* συν-εφ-ίστημι

to place over. Pass.,
1. to stand over (Thuc.).
2. to rise together: seq. κατά, c. gen. pers. (against), Ac 16:22.†

title: συνέχω
content:
συν-έχω [in LXX for עצר, חבר, etc. ;]

1. to hold together (τ. συνέχον τ. πάντα, Wi 1:7): of closing the ears, Ac 7:57 (τ. στόμα, Is 52:15); to hem in, press on every side: Lk 8:45 19:43.
2. to hold fast;
(a) of a prisoner, to hold in charge (Luc.; cf. exx. in Deiss., BS, 160; MM, xxiv): Lk 22:63;
(b) to constrain: II Co 5:14; pass., Lk 12:50, Ac 18:5 (τ. λόγῳ; cf. Field, Notes, 128), Phl 1:23; in pass., of ills, to be seized or afflicted by, suffering from: Mt 4:24, Lk 4:38 8:37, Ac 28:8.†

title: συνζάω
content:
* συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-),

to live with: opp. to συναποθανεῖν, II Co 7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Ro 6:8, II Ti 2:11.†

title: συνζεύγνυμι
content:
συν-ζεύγνυμι (Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Ez 1:11, 23 (חבר) * ;]

to yoke to­gether: metaph., of union in wedlock, Mt 19:6, Mk 10:9.†

title: συνζητέω
content:
συν-ζητέω (Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Ne 2:4 AB1 (בּקשׁ pi.) * ;]

1. to search or examine together (Plat.).
2. In NT (and π., v. MM, xxiii; also in MGr., v. Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Mk 1:27 12:28, Lk 24:15; seq. quæst. indir., Mk 9:10; c. dat. pers., Mk 8:11 Ac 6:9; seq. πρός, c. acc pers., Mk 9:14, 16, Ac 9:29; id. seq. quæst. indir., Lk 22:23.†

title: συνζήτησις
content:
*† συν-ζήτησις (Rec. συζ-), -εως, ἡ

disputation: Ac 28:29 (WH, R, txt., om.).†

title: συνζητητής
content:
*† συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ (< συνζητέω),

a disputer, disputant: I Co 1:20.†

title: σύνζυγος
content:
** σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον (< συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Ez 23:21 * ;]

a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Phl 4:3 (v. ICC, Lft., in l.; MM, xxiii).†

title: συνζωοποιέω
content:
*† συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-,

to make alive or quicken together with; metaph., of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph 2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Col 2:13.†

title: συνήδομαι
content:
* συν-ήδομαι

to rejoice together; c. dat., to rejoice with or in: τ. νόμῳ τ. θεοῦ, Ro 7:22 (v. Lft., Notes, 304).†

title: συνήθεια
content:
** συνήθεια, -ας, ἡ (< ἦθος), [in LXX: IV Mac 2:12 6:13 13:22, 27 * ;]

1 intimacy.
2. habit, custom: Jo 18:39, I Co 11:16; c. gen. obj. (cf. Æschin., 23, 37, and v. MM, xxiv), habitual use, force of habit with respect to, I Co 8:7.†

title: συνηλικιώτης
content:
*† συν-ηλικιώτης (< ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.),

one of the same age, an equal in age: Ga 1:14.†

title: συνθάπτω
content:
* συν-θάπτω

to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, αὐτῷ (with Christ), Ro 6:4, Col 2:12.†

title: συνθλάω
content:
συν-θλάω, -ῶ [in LXX for מחץ etc. ;]

to crush together, crush: Mt 21:44 ([WH], R, mg., om.), Lk 20:18.†

title: συνθλίβω
content:
συν-θλίβω [in LXX: Ec 12:6 א A (רצץ), Si 34 (31):14, I Mac 15:14 A * ;]

to press together, press on all sides: Mk 5:24, 31.†

title: συνθρύπτω
content:
*† συν-θρύπτω

to break in pieces, crush: metaph., τ. καρδίαν, Ac 21:13.†

title: συνίημι
content:
συν-ίημι and συνίω (v. Bl., § 23, 7), [in LXX chiefly for בּין hi., שׂכל hi. ;]

1. to bring or set together.
2. Metaph., to perceive, understand: Mt 13:13–15 (LXX), 19 15:10, Mk 4:9 (WH, mg.), 12 7:14 8:17, 21 Lk 8:10, Ac 7:25 28:26, 27, Ro 15:21 (LXX), II Co 10:12; c. acc. rei, Mt 13:23, 51, Lk 2:50 18:34 24:45; seq. ὅτι, Mt 16:12 17:13; seq. quæst. indir., Eph 5:17; ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, Mk 6:52; as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, Ro 3:11 (LXX).†

title: συνιστάνω
content: συνιστάνω and συνιστάω, v.s. συνίστημι.

title: συνίστημι
content:
συν-ίστημι [in LXX for צוה pi., קהל ni., etc.; I Mac 12:43, II Mac 4:24, III Mac 1:19 (and freq. in these books) ;]

1. trans.,
(a) to commend, recommend: c. acc. pers., II Co 3:1 6:4 10:12, 18; id. c. dat., Ro 16:1 (as freq. at the beginning of a letter; Deiss., LAE, 226), II Co 5:12; seq. πρός, II Co 4:2; pass., seq. ὑπό, II Co 12:11;
(b) to show, prove, establish: c. acc., Ro 3:5 5:8, II Co 6:4; dupl. acc., Ga 2:13; acc. et inf., II Co 7:11
2. Intrans., pf., συνέστηκα (as also 2 aor. and plpf.);
(a) to stand with or near: Lk 9:32;
(b) to be composed of, consist, cohere: Col 1:17 (v. Lft., in l.), II Pe 3:5.†

title: συνκάθημαι
content:
συν-κάθημαι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 100 (101):6 (ישׁב) * ;]

to sit together or with: c. dat., Ac 26:30; seq. μετά, c. gen., Mk 14:54.†

title: συνκαθίζω׀συγκαθίζω
content:
συν-καθίζω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX for ישׁב, רבץ ;]

1. trans., to make to sit together: c. acc. pers., seq. ἐν, Eph 2:6.
2. Intrans. = mid., to sit together: Lk 22:55.†

title: συνκακοπαθέω
content:
*† συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,

to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: II Ti 2:3; c. dat. commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, ib. 1:18.†

title: συνκακουχέομαι
content:
*† συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass.

to endure adversity with: c. dat. pers., He 11:25. Not elsewhere.†

title: συνκαλέω
content:
συν-καλέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for קרא ;]

to call together: c. acc., Mk 15:16, Lk 15:6, 9 (v.l. -εῖται, v. B1., § 55, 1), Ac 5:21. Mid., to call together to oneself : Lk 9:1 (and v.l. in 15:6, 9 v. supr.) 23:13, Ac 10:24 28:17.†

title: συνκαλύπτω
content:
συν-καλύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for כּסה pi. ;]

to veil or cover completely: c. acc., pass., Lk 12:2.†

title: συνκάμπτω
content:
συν-κάμπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 68:10, 23(מעדhi.), etc. ;]

to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, fig., Ro 11:10 (LXX).†

title: συνκαταβαίνω
content:
συν-κατα-βαίνω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 48 (49):17 (ירד), Wi 10:13, Da LXX TH 3:49 * ;]

to go down with: Ac 25:5. In late writers also metaph. (Wis, l.c.), to condescend, on wh. v. Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.†

title: συνκατάθεσις
content:
*† συν-κατά-θεσις (Rec συγκ-), -εως, ἡ (< συνκατατίθημι)

concord, agreement: II Co 6:16 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†

title: συνκατανεύω
content:
*† συν-κατα-νεύω

to agree, consent to: Ac 18:27, WH, mg. (Polyb.).†

title: συνκατατίθημι
content:
συν-κατα-τίθημι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ex 23:1 (יָד שִׁית), ib. 32 (כּרת), Da TH Su 1:20 * ;]

to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: c. dat., Lk 23:51.†

title: συνκαταψηφίζω
content:
*† συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-),

1. to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21).
2. to vote one a place among: pass., Ac 1:26. Not elsewhere .†

title: συνκεράννυμι
content:
συν-κεράννυμι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Da LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), II Mac 15:39 * ;]

to mix or blend together, compound: c. acc., I Co 12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., He 4:2, T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, c. dat. instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (v. Westc., in l.).†

title: συνκινέω
content:
* συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,

to move together. Metaph., to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, Ac 6:12 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

title: συνκλείω
content:
συν-κλείω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר;]

to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, Lk 5:6; metaph. (Ps 30 (31):9, al.), Ro 11:32, Ga 3:22, 23.†

title: συνκληρονόμος
content:
*† συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ

a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: Ro 8:17, Eph 3:6; c. gen. rei, He 11:9, I Pe 3:7 (for exx., v. Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).†

title: συνκοινωνέω
content:
* συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,

to have fellowship with or in (in cl., c. gen. rei, dat. pers.): c. dat. rei, Eph 5:11, Re 18:4; id. c. gen. pers., Phl 4:14.†

title: συνκοινωνός
content:
*† συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν,

partaking jointly of: c. gen. rei, Ro 11:17, I Co 9:23; id. c. gen. pers., Phl 1:7; seq. ἐν, Re 1:9.†

title: συνκομίζω
content:
συν-κομίζω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jb 5:26 (עלה) * ;]

1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.).
2. to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): Ac 8:2 (v. Field, Notes, 116).†

title: συνκρίνω
content:
συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-) [in LXX chiefly for פּתר ;]

1. to compound, combine: I Co 2:13, R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.).
2. In Arist. and later writers (Wi 7:29, al.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: I Co, l.c., R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), II Co 10:12
3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret (Ge 40:8, I Co, l.c., R, mg.2 (but v. reff. supr.).†

title: συνκύπτω
content:
συν-κύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jb 9:27 (עזב), Si 12:11 19:26 * ;]

1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
2. to be bowed down: Lk 13:11.†

title: συνλαλέω
content:
συν-λαλέω (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for דּברpi.,שִׂיחַ;]

to talk with or together: (c. dat. pers., Mk 9:4, Lk 9:30 22:4; seq. μετά, c. gen., Mt 17:3, Ac 25:12; . πρός, c. acc., Lk 4:36.†

title: συνλυπέω
content:
συν-λυπέω (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Ps 68 (69):20, Is 51:19 (נוּד) * ;]

to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: seq. ἐπί, c. dat., Mk 3:5.†

title: συνμαθητής
content:
* συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ

a fellow-disciple: Jo 11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

title: συνμαρτυρέω
content:
* συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ,

to bear witness with: Ro 2:15; c. dat., Ro 8:16; seq. ὅτι, Ro 9:1.†

title: συνμερίζω
content:
† συν-μερίζω (Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: Pr 29:24 א2 (חלק) * ;]

to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: I Co 9:13 (Diod., al.).†

title: συνμέτοχος
content:
* συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον,

partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (c. dat. pers. et gen. rei, FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): c. gen. rei, Eph 3:6; c. gen. pers., ib. 5:7 (Arist.).†

title: συνμιμητής
content:
*† συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ

a fellow-imitator: c. gen. obj., Phl 3:17 (v. ICC, in l.). Not elsewhere.†

title: συνμορφίζω
content: συν-μορφίζω, v.s. συμμορφίζω.

title: συνοδεύω
content:
† συν-οδεύω [in LXX: Za 8:21 א1 (הלך), To 5:16א, Wi 6:23 * ;]

to journey with: c. dat. pers., Ac 9:7 (Plut., al.).†

title: συνοδία
content:
συνοδία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: Ne 7:5, 64 (יחשׂ) * ;]

1. a journey in company (Plut., al.).
2. By meton., a company of travellers, a caravan: Lk 2:44.†

title: σύνοιδα
content:
σύν-οιδα, pf. with Pres. meaning (v.s. οἶδα), [in LXX: Le 5:1 (ידע), Jb 27:6; ptcp., I Mac 4:21 A, II Mac 4:41 A, III Mac 2:8 R * ;]

1. to share the knowledge of, be privy to (Hdt., Thuc., al.): ptcp., Ac 5:2.
2. C. pron. reflex., to be conscious of (Eur., Plat., al.), esp. of guilty consciousness: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ σ., for I know nothing against myself, I Co 4:4.†

title: συνοικέω
content:
συν-οικέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בּעל etc. ;]

to dwell together: of man and wife (Hdt., al.), c. dat. pers., I Pe 3:7,†

title: συνοικοδομέω
content:
** συν-οικοδομέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I Es 5:68 * ;]

1. to build together or with (c. dat. pers., I Es, l.c.).
2. Of various materials, to build up together (Thuc., al.): metaph., of Christians, Eph 2:22.†

title: συνομιλέω
content:
* συν-ομιλέω, -ῶ

to converse with (absol., FlJ, BJ, v, 13, 1; seq. μετά, Cebes, 13): c. dat. pers., Ac 10:27.†

title: συνομορέω
content:
*† συν-ομορέω, -ῶ

to border on: c. dat., Ac 18:7 (Byz.).†

title: συνοράω
content: συν-οράω, v.s. συνεῖδον.

title: συνοχή
content:
συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή (< συνέχω), [in LXX: Jg 2:3 (?), Jb 30:3 (שׁוֺאָה), ib. 38:28 A; Mi 5:1 (4:14), Je 52:5 (מָצוֹר) * ;]

1. a holding or being held together.
2. a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaph., straits, distress: Lk 21:25; καρδίας, II Co 2:4.†

title: συνπαθέω
content:
** συν-παθέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: IV Mac 5:25 AR 13:23 * ;]

to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: c. dat. rei, He 4:15; dat. pers., ib. 10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).†

title: συνπαραγίνομαι
content:
συν-παρα-γίνομαι (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Ps 82 (83):8 (לוה ni.) * ;]

1. to come up or be present together: seq. ἐπί, Lk 23:48.
2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; II Ti 4:16, Rec.).†

title: συνπαρακαλέω
content:
* συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,

to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Ro 1:12.†

title: συνπαραλαμβάνω
content:
συν-παρα-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Ge 19:17 (ספה ni.), Jb 1:4 (שׁלח), III Mac 1:1 * ;]

to take along with: as a companion, c. acc., Ac 12:25 15:37, 38 (on the tenses, v. M, Pr., 130), Ga 2:1.†

title: συνπάρειμι
content:
συν-πάρειμι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: To 12:12 ΑΒ, Pr 8:27 (?), Wi 9:10 * ;]

to be present together or with: c. dat. pers., Ac 25:24.†

title: συνπάσχω
content:
** συν-πάσχω (Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: I Ki 22:8 * ;]

1. to suffer together or with: Ro 8:17, I Co 12:26.
2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†

title: συνπέμπω
content:
* συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-)

to send together with: c. acc. et dat., II Co 8:22; id. seq. μετά, c. gen., ib. 18.†

title: συνπεριλαμβάνω
content:
συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-),

1. to enclose (Ez 5:3 (צוּר) *).
2. to embrace: c. acc. pers., Ac 20:10.†

title: συνπίνω
content:
συν-πίνω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Es 7:1 (עִם שָׁתָה) ;]

to drink with c. dat. pers., Ac 10:41.†

title: συνπίπτω
content:
συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX for נפל, etc. ;]

to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), Lk 6:49.†

title: συνπληρόω
content:
συν-πληρόω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Je 25:12 (מָלֵא) * ;]

1. to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, Lk 8:23.
2. to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.c., and v. MM, xxiv), Lk 9:51, Ac 2:1 (on the "durative inf.," v. M, Pr., 233).†

title: συνπνίγω
content:
* συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-),

to choke: of thronging by a crowd, Lk 8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Mt 13:22, Mk 4:7, 19, Lk 8:14.†

title: συνπολίτης
content:
* συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ

a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opp. to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Eph 2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

title: συνπορεύομαι
content:
συν-πορεύομαι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]

1. to journey together (Plat., al.): c. dat. pers., Lk 7:11 14:25 24:15.
2. to come together: Mk 10:1 (Plut., al.).†

title: συνπρεσβύτερος
content:
*† συν-πρεσβύτερος (Rec. συμπ-), -ου, ὁ

a fellow-elder: I Pe 5:1 (Eccl.).†

title: συνσ-
content: συνσ-, v. passim συσσ-.

title: σύνσωμος
content:
*† σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον (< σῶμα),

of the same body: Eph 3:6 (Eccl.).†

title: συνσταυρόω
content:
* συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ,

to crucify together with: pass., c. dat., Jo 19:32; id. seq. σύν, Mt 27:44, Mk 15:32. Metaph., of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: Ro 6:6, Ga 2:20 (Eccl.).†

title: συνστέλλω
content:
συν-στέλλω (Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Jg 8:28 11:33 (כּנע ni.), Si 4:31, al. ;]

1. to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, I Co 7:29.
2. to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), c. acc., Ac 5:6.†

title: συνστενάζω
content:
* συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-),

to groan together or with: Ro 8:22 (c. dat. pers., Eur., Ion., 935).†

title: συνστοιχέω
content:
*† συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ,

to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaph., to correspond to: Ga 4:25 (v. Lft., in l.).†

title: συνστρατιώτης
content:
* συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ

a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaph., of fellowship in Christian service: Phl 2:25, Phm 2 .†

title: συνσχηματιζω
content:
* συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), (< σχῆμα),

to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Ro 12:2, I Pe 1:14.†

title: συντάσσω
content:
συν-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צוה pi. ;]

to prescribe, ordain, arrange: c. dat. pers, Mt 21:6 26:19 27:10 (LXX).†

title: συντέλεια
content:
συντέλεια, -ας, ἡ (< συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קֵץ ;]

1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.).
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Da LXX TH 12:13, al.), Mt 13:39, 40, 49 24:3 28:20, He 9:26.†

title: συντελέω
content:
συν-τελέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for כּלה pi., also for עשׂה, תּמם, etc. ;]

"perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118),
1. to complete, finish, bring to an end: Lk 4:13; pass., ib. 2, Jo 2:3, WH, mg., Ac 21:27.
2. to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): Mk 13:4, Ro 9:28, He 8:8.†

title: συντέμνω
content:
συν-τέμνω [in LXX chiefly for חרץ ;]

1. to cut in pieces.
2. to cut down, cut short: metaph., λόγον, Ro 9:28 (LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Eur., al.).†

title: συντηρέω
content:
συν-τηρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Ez 18:19 (שׁמר), Da TH 7:28 A (נְטַר), Si 13:12 and freq., To 1:11, II Mac 12:42, al. ;]

"perfective" of τηρέω (v. M, Pr., 113, 116),
1. to preserve, keep safe, keep close: c. acc. pers., Mk 6:20; c. acc. rei, Mt 9:17; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Lk 2:19 (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).†

title: συντίθημι
content:
συν-τίθημι [in LXX: I Ki 22:13 (קשׁר), etc. ;]

to place or put together, in various senses. Mid.,
(a) to observe, perceive;
(b) to determine, agree, covenant: c. inf., Lk 22:5; seq. τοῦ, c. inf., Ac 23:20; seq. ἵνα, Jo 9:22.†

title: συντόμως
content:
συν-τόμως, adv. (< συντέμνω) [in LXX: Pr 13:23 (בְּלֹאמׅשְׁפָּט) 23:28, III Mac 5:25 * ;]

concisely, briefly: Ac 24:4 (for a similar ex., v. MM, xxiv).†

title: συντρέχω
content:
συν-τρέχω [in LXX: Ps 49 (50):18 (עִם רָצָה), II Mac 2, Jdt 4 * ;]

to run together or with: seq. ἐκεῖ, Mk 6:33; πρόσ, c. acc., Ac 3:11; metaph., I Pe 4:4.†

title: συντρίβω
content:
συν-τρίβω [in LXX chiefly for שׁבר ;]

to shatter, break in pieces: Mt 12:20 (LXX), Mk 5:4 14:3, Jo 19:36 (LXX), Re 2:27; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: Lk 9:39; fig., Ro 16:20.†

title: σύντριμμα
content:
σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό (< συντρίβω), [in LXX (Le 21:19, al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד (Is 59:7), etc. ;]

a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.c., al.). Metaph., calamity, destruction (Isa, l.c., Wi 3:3, al.): Ro 3:16 (LXX).†

title: σύντροφος
content:
σύν-τροφος, -ου, ὁ (< συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: III Ki 12:24, I Mac 1:6 R, II Mac 9:29 * ;]

1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother: Ac 13:1 EV.
2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (v. Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): Ac 13:1 (cf. also MM, xxiv).†

title: συντυγχάνω
content:
** συν-τυγχάνω [in LXX: II Mac 8:14 * ;]

to meet with, fall in with: c. dat. pers., Lk 8:19.†

title: Συντύχη
content:
Συντύχη (T, -τυχή), -ης, ἡ

Syntyche: Phl 4:2.†

title: συνυποκρίνομαι
content:
*† συν-υπο-κρίνομαι

to play a part with, dissemble with: c. dat., Ga 2:13 (Polyb.).†

title: συνυπουργέω
content:
* συν-υπουργέω, -ῶ

to help together, join in serving: c. dat. instr., II Co 1:11.†

title: σύνφημι
content:
* σύν-φημι (Rec. συμ-),

to consent, confess: c. dat., seq. ὅτι, Ro 7:16.†

title: συνφύω
content:
** συν-φύω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wi 13:13 * ;]

to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Lk 8:7.†

title: συνχαίρω
content:
συν-χαίρω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: Ge 21:6 (צחק), III Mac 1:8 R * ;]

1. to rejoice with: c. dat pers., Lk 1:58 15:6, 9, Phl 2:17, 18, EV; c. dat. rei, I Co 12:26 13:6.
2. to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phl, l.c. (Lft., in l.; cf. MM, xxiv).†

title: συνχέω
content:
συν-χέω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בּלל, רגז, etc. ;]

to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaph., confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: Ac 21:27 (cf. συν-χύννω).†

title: συνχράομαι
content:
**† συν-χράομαι (Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: I Ki 30:19 * ;]

to use together with. Metaph., c. dat. pers., to associate with: Jo 4:9 (Polyb., al.).†

title: συνχύννω
content:
*† συν-χύννω (Rec. συγ-; and in Ac 9:22 with LTr., as in late writers generally, -χύνω)

Hellenistic form of -χέω (q.v.): Ac 2:6 9:22 19:32 21:31.†

title: σύνψυχος
content:
*† σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον (< ψυχή),

of one mind: Phl 2:2.†

title: συνωδίνω
content:
* συν-ωδίνω

to be in travail together (Arist.): metaph. (Eur.), Ro 8:22.†

title: συνωμοσία
content:
** συνωμοσία, -ας, ή (συνόμνυμι, to conspire), [in Sm.: Ez 22:25 * ;]

a conspiracy: Ac 23:13.†

title: Συράκουσαι
content:
Συράκουσαι, -ῶν, αἱ

Syracuse: Ac 28:12.†

title: Συρία
content:
Συρία, -ας, ή

Syria: Mt 4:24, Lk 2:2, Ac 15:23, 41 18:18 20:3 21:3, Ga 1:21.†

title: Σύρος
content:
Σύρος, -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα,

a Syrian: Lk 4:27, Mk 7:26, WH, mg.†

title: Συροφοινίκισσα
content:
Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ

a Syropænician woman: Mk 7:26, WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).†

title: Σύρτις
content:
Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, acc. -ιν, ἡ,

Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast: Ac 27:17.†

title: σύρω
content:
σύρω [in LXX: IV Ki 17:13 (סחב), IV Mac 6:1, al. ;]

to draw, drag: c. acc. rei, Jo 21:8, Re 12:4; c. acc. pers., of taking to trial or punish­ment, Ac 8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Ac 14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. IV Mac, l.c.), Ac 17:6 (cf. κατα-σύρω).†

title: συσπαράσσω
content:
*† συ-σπαράσσω

to convulse completely: c. acc. pers., Mk 9:20, Lk 9:42 (cf. σπαράσσω).†

title: σύσσημον
content:
† σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό (< σῆμα), [in LXX: Jg 20:38, 40 (מַשְׂאֵת), Is 5:26 49:22 62:10 (נֵס) * ;]

a fixed sign or signal: Mk 14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) †

title: συστασιαστής
content:
*† συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ,

a fellow-rioter: Mk 15:7, Rec.†

title: συστατικός
content:
* συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν (< συνίστημι),

1. for putting together, constructive.
2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and v. MM, xxiv), II Co 3:1.†

title: συστρέφω
content:
συ-στρέφω [in LXX chiefly for קשׁר ;]

1. to twist together: c. acc. rei, Ac 28:3.
2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mt 17:22 (WH, R, mg.).†

title: συστροφή
content:
συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (< συστρέφω), [in LXX: Ho 4:19 13:12 (צרר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Am 7:10 (קשׁר), etc. ;]

1. a twisting together (Plat.).
2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Ac 19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.c.), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Ac 23:12.†

title: Συχάρ
content:
Συχάρ (Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ,

Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jo 4:5.†

title: Συχέμ
content:
Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם),

Shechem;
1. the son of Hamor (Ge 33:19): Ac 7:16 b, Rec.
2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Ac 7:16 a,b.†

title: σφαγή
content:
σφαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (< σφάζω), [in LXX for טֶבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;]

slaughter: Ac 8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Ro 8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Ja 5:5.†

title: σφάγιον
content:
σφάγιον, -ου, τό (< σφαγή), [in LXX: Am 5:25 (זֶבַח), Ez 21:10, 15, 28 (טֶבַח), Le 22:23 (נְדָבָה) * ;]

a victim for slaughter: Ac 7:42 (LXX).†

title: σφάζω
content:
σφάζω [in LXX chiefly for שׁחט ;]

to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Re 5:6, 12 13:8; of persons, I Jo 3:12, Re 5:9 6:4, 9 18:24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Re 13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).†

title: σφόδρα
content:
σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד ;]

very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, Mt 17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54, Ac 6:7; with adjectives, Mt 2:10, Mk 16:4, Lk 18:23, Re 16:21.†

title: σφοδρῶς
content:
σφοδρῶς adv.,

exceedingly: Ac 27:18.†

title: σφραγίζω
content:
σφραγίζω [in LXX chiefly for חתם (De 32:34, al.), also for סתם (Da TH 8:26) ;]

to seal,
(a) for security: Mt 27:66, Re 20:3; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, fig. (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), Ro 15:28;
(b) for concealment, hence, metaph., to hide (Da TH 9:24, Jo 14:17): Re 10:4 22:10;
(c) for distinction, Re 7:3–8; metaph., Eph 1:13 4:30; mid., II Co 1:22;
(d) for authentication (Es 8:8): Jo 3:33 6:27 (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).†

title: σφραγίς
content:
σφραγίς, -ῖδος, ἡ [in LXX: Ex 28:11, al. (חֹתָם) 35:22 (חָח), Si 17:22, al. ;]

1. a seal, signet: Re 7:2.
2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, v.s. σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Re 5:1, 2, 5, 9 6:1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12 8:1; metaph., Ro 4:11, I Co 9:2, II Ti 2:19, Re 9:4.†

title: σφυδρόν
content:
*† σφυδρόν, -οῦ, τό

= σφυρόν,
the ankle: Ac 3:7 (v. Bl., § 6, 8).†

title: σφυρίς
content:
* σφυρίς (T, Rec. σπυρίς, v. WH, App., 148; Bl., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ,

a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: Mt 15:37 16:10, Mk 8:8, 20 Ac 9:25 (v.s. κόφινος).†

title: σφυρόν
content:
σφυρόν, -οῦ, τό, [in LXX: Jb 41:20(21) (תּוֺתָח) * ;]

the ankle: Ac 3:7, Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; v. Bl., § 6, 8).†

title: σχέδον
content:
** σχέδον adv. (< ἔχω), [in LXX: II Mac 5:2, III Mac 5:14, 45 * ;]

1. of place, near.
2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Ac 13:44 19:26, He 9:22.†

title: σχῆμα
content:
σχῆμα, -τος, τό (< ἔχω), [in LXX: Is 3:17 (פֹּת) * ;]

figure, fashion: I Co 7:31, Phl 2:8.†
SYN.: v.s. μορφή

title: σχίζω
content:
σχίζω [in LXX chiefly for בּקע ;]

to cleave, rend: Mt 27:51, Mk 1:10 15:38, Lk 5:36 23:45, Jo 19:24 21:11; metaph., in pass., to be divided into factions, Ac 14:4 23:7.†

title: σχίσμα
content:
* σχίσμα, -τος, τό (< σχίζω),

a rent (Arist., al.): Mt 9:16, Mk 2:21. Metaph., a dissension, division: Jo 7:43 9:16 10:19, I Co 1:10 11:18 12:25.†
SYN.: v.s. αἵρεσις

title: σχοινίον
content:
σχοινίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), [in LXX chiefly for חֶבֶל;]

a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jo 2:15, Ac 27:32.†

title: σχολάζω
content:
σχολάζω (< σχολή), [in LXX: Ex 5:8, 17, Ps 45 (46):10 (רפה ni., hi.) * ;]

to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: I Co 7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Mt 12:44, Lk 11:25 (T [WH], R, om.).†

title: σχολή
content:
σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: Ge 33:14 (κατὰ σ., לְאִטִּי), Pr 28:19, Si 38:24 * ;]

1. leisure.
2. Later (from Plato on),
(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture;
(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Ac 19:9 (for the later sense of employment, v. MM, xxiv).†

title: σώζω
content:
σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, v. WH, Intr., § 410; Bl., §3, 1–3), [in LXX chiefly for ישׁע hi., also for מלט ni., נצל ni., etc. ;]

to save from peril, injury or suffering: Mt 8:25, Mk 13:20, Lk 23:35, al.; τ. ψυχήν, Mt 16:25, al.; seq. ἐκ, Jo 12:27, He 5:7, Ju 5; of healing, restoring to health: Mt 9:22, Mk 5:34, al. In NT, esp. of salvation from spiritual disease and death, in which sense it is "spoken of in Scripture as either (1) past, (2) present, or (3) future, according as redemption, grace, or glory is the point in view. Thus (1) Ro 8:24, Eph 2:5, 8 II Ti 1:9, Tit 3:5; (2) Ac 2:47, I Co 1:18, 15:2, II Co 2:15; (3) Mt 10:22, Ro 13:11, Phl 2:12, He 9:28" (Vau. on Ro 5:9). Seq. ἀπό, Mt 1:21, Ac 2:40, Ro 5:9; ἐκ, Ja 5:20, Ju 23 (cf. Cremer, 532 ff.).

title: σῶμα
content:
σῶμα, -τος, τό, [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה ,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה ;]

a body.
1. Prop., of the human body,
(a) as always in Hom. (opp. to δέμας), of the dead body: Mt 27:58, 59 Mk 15:43, al.;
(b) of the living body: Lk 11:34, I Co 6:13, al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, He 13:3; as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., II Co 5:10; opp. to πνεῦμα, Ro 8:10, I Co 5:3 7:4, Ja 2:26; to ψυχή, Mt 6:25 10:28, Lk 12:22 (cf. Wi 1:4, al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., I Th 5:23; σ. ψυχικόν, opp. to σ. πνευματικόν, I Co 15:44; ὁ ναὸς τοῦ σ. αὐτοῦ (gen. epexeg.), Jo 2:21; τὸ σ. τ. ταπεινώσεως ἡμῶν (Hebraistic "gen. of definition"; M, Pr., 73 f.; Bl., §35, 5), opp. to τὸ σ. τ. δοξῆς αὐτοῦ, Phl 3:21; similarly, τὸ σ. τ. σαρκός, Col 1:22; σ. τοῦ θανάτου (subject to death), Ro 7:24; σ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, Ro 6:6;
(c) periphr., ἀνθρώπου, then absol., σῶμα (Soph., Xen., al.), a person, and in later writers (Polyb., al.), a slave: Re 18:13 (cf. MM, i, ii, xxiv; Deiss., BS, 160).
2. Of the bodies of animals: living, Ja 3:3; dead, He 13:11 ( Ex 29:14, al.).
3. Of inanimate objects (cf. Eng. "heavenly bodies"): I Co 15:37, 38, 40 (Diod., al.).
4. Of any corporeal substance (Plat., al.): opp. to σκιά, Col 2:17. Metaph., of a number of persons united by a common bond; in NT, of the Church as the spiritual body of Christ: Ro 12:5, I Co 10:16, 17 12:13, 27, Eph 1:23 2:16 4:4, 12, 16 5:23, 30, Col 1:18, 24 2:19 3:15; ἓν σ. κ. ἓν πνεῦμα, Eph 4:4.

title: σωματικός
content:
** σωματικός, -ή, -όν (< σῶμα), [in LXX: IV Mac 1:32 3:1 * ;]

(a) of or for the body, bodily: γυμνασία, I Ti 4:8;
(b) (opp. to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal: εἶδος, Lk 3:22.†

title: σωματικῶς
content:
* σωματικῶς adv.,

bodily, corporeally: Col 2:9 (v. ICC, Lft., in l.).†

title: Σώπατρος
content:
Σώπατρος, -ου, ὁ

Sopater: Ac 20:4.†

title: σωρεύω
content:
σωρεύω [in LXX: Pr 25:22 (חתה), Jth 15:11 * ;]

(a) to heap on: c. acc. seq. ἐπί c. acc., Ro 12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.);
(b) to heap with: c. acc. et dat., metaph., ἁμαρτίαις, II Ti 3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes, 217) (Polyb.).†

title: Σωσθένης
content:
Σωσθένης, -ου, ὁ

Sosthenes;
(a) a Jewish ruler: Ac 18:7;
(b) a Christian: I Co 1:1.†

title: Σωσίπατρος
content:
Σωσίπατρος, -ου, ὁ

Sosipater: Ro 16:21.†

title: σωτήρ
content:
σωτήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ (< σώζω), [in LXX for יֵשַׁע and cognate forms ;]

saviour, deliverer, preserver, a freq. epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT,
(a) of God (as LXX: Ps 23 (24):5, Is 12:2, al.): Lk 1:47, I Ti 1:1 2:3 4:10, Tit 1:3 2:10 3:4, Ju 25;
(b) of Christ: Lk 2:11, Ac 5:31 13:23, Phl 3:20; τ. κόσμου, Jo 4:42, I Jo 4:14 (for the general use of the word, v. Westc., in l.); ἡμῶν, II Ti 1:10, Tit 1:4 3:6; θεὸς (κύριος) καὶ σ. (v. Deiss., LAE, 3484; M, Pr., 84), Tit 2:13, II Pe 1:1, 11 2:20 3:2, 18; σ. τοῦ σώματος (i.e. of the Church; v.s. σῶμα, 5), Eph 5:23.†

title: σωτηρία
content:
σωτηρία, -ας, ἡ (< σωτήρ), [in LXX for יֶשַׁע, יְשׁוּעָה, תְּשׁוּעָה, פְּלֵיטָה, etc. ;]

deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): Ac 7:25 27:34, He 11:7; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, Lk 1:71. In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (v.s. σώζω): Lk 19:9, Jo 4:22, Ac 4:12 13:47, Ro 11:11, II Th 2:13, II Ti 3:15, He 2:3 6:9, II Pe 3:15, Ju 3; opp. to ἀπηώλεια, Phl 1:28; αἰώνιος-., He 5:9; ὁ λόγος (τὸ εὐαγγέλιον) τῆς σ., Ac 13:26, Eph 1:13; ὁδὸς σωτηρίας, Ac 16:17; κέρας σωτηρίας, Lk 1:69; ἡμέρα σωτηρίας, II Co 6:2 (LXX); κατεργάζεσθαι τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σ., Phl 2:12; κληρονομεῖν σ., He 1:14; ὁ ἀρχηγὸς τῆς σ., He 2:10; εἰς σ., Ro 1:16 10:1, 10, I Pe 2:2; σ. as a present possession (v.s. σώζω), Lk 1:77, II Co 1:6 7:10, Phl 1:19, II Ti 2:10; as more fully realized in the future: Ro 13:11, I Th 5:8, 9, He 9:28, I Pe 1:5, 9, 10, Re 7:10 12:10 19:1.†

title: σωτήριον
content: σωτήριον, v.s. σωτήριος.

title: σωτήριος
content:
σωτήριος, -ον (< σωτήρ), [in LXX for יְשׁוּעָה, שֶׁלֶם, etc. ;]

saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (v.s. σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., Tit 2:11. Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation: Lk 2:30; τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, Lk 3:6, Ac 28:28; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., Eph 6:17.†

title: σωφρονέω
content:
* σωφρονέω, -ῶ (< σώφρων),

(a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind: Mk 5:15, Lk 8:35; opp. to ἐκστῆναι, II Co 5:13 (Hdt.);
(b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opp. to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; Æsch., Thuc., al.): Tit 2:6; opp. to ὑπερφρονεῖν, Ro 12:3; σ. καὶ νήφειν, I Pe 4:7.†

title: σωφρονίζω
content:
** σωφρονίζω [in Aq.: Is 38:16 * ;]

to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): c. acc. pers., Tit 2:4.†

title: σωφρονισμός
content:
*† σωφρονισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (< σωφρονίζω),

(a) an admonishing (FlJ, Plut., al.);
(b) self-control, self-discipline: II Ti 1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, v. Ellic., in l.).†

title: σωφρόνως
content:
** σωφρόνως adv., [in LXX: Wi 9:11 * ;]

with sound mind, prudently, soberly: Tit 2:12.†

title: σωφροσύνη
content:
** σωφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: Es 3:13, Wi 8:7, II Mac 4:37, IV Mac 6 * ;]

(a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opp. to μανία, Xen.): Ac 26:25;
(b) self-control, sobriety: I Ti 2:9 (v. Tr., Syn., § xx), ib. 15.†

title: σώφρων
content:
** σώφρων, -ον [in LXX: IV Mac 9 * ;]

(a) of sound mind, sane, sensible;
(b) self-controlled, sober-minded: I Ti 3:2, Tit 1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).†
